title: Operating rules
intro: Control when writes to {{device}} are allowed, using observations from other equipment.
emptyTitle: No operating rules for this device
emptyDescription: Add a condition that must be met before a specific write can be sent to this device.
name: Name
explanationHelp: Explain the equipment relationship and why this write must be guarded.
targetHelp: This operating rule applies only to the selected attribute and requested value on this device.
conditionHelp: A true condition allows the write. A known prohibition blocks it. Unknown or stale information blocks automatic commands and requires explicit, recorded confirmation for manual commands.
brokenAttribute: The attribute {{device}} / {{attribute}} is missing or unavailable. Select a valid replacement.
candidateHelp: The value requested by the governed write, without changing the equipment state.
implicitAttribute: This reference needs an explicit device
emptyAll: An empty “all” condition is always true.
emptyAny: An empty “any” condition is always false.

operatorLabel.lte: Is less than or equal to
operatorLabel.gte: Is greater than or equal to
operatorLabel.any: At least one condition is true

formInvalid: Complete the required fields and check the selected attributes, values and conditions.
invalidDefinition: The operating rule is invalid. Check the attribute types, freshness duration and condition structure.
failed: Unable to save or load this operating rule. Please try again.
conflict: This operating rule changed since you opened it. Your draft is preserved. Load the latest version and review it before saving again.
reconcileHelp: Review the saved version above. You can use it, or keep your draft for the next save. Saving your draft will replace this version.
keepDraft: Keep my draft for the next save
retiredHelp: This operating rule has been retired. Its history remains available; it can no longer be edited.
readOnly: Only administrators can manage operating rules.
limits: An operating rule refuses a write; it never stops equipment. Concurrent starts are not mutually exclusive and hardware interlocks remain necessary where required.
notEnforced: A referenced attribute is invalid — this rule blocks governed writes.
attributeGone: The attribute {{id}} is no longer writable on this device. Choose another before saving.
freshnessHelp: Off by default: use the last observed value, regardless of its age. Values that have never been received or have been invalidated remain unknown.
maxAgeHelp: Applies to every attribute used by this condition. After this duration without a new observation, its value is treated as unknown. This setting does not request new readings.
maxAgeInvalid: Enter a duration greater than zero.
enabledHelp: The condition is checked before each governed write.
disabledHelp: This rule no longer checks writes. You can enable it again at any time.
deleteHelp: This rule will be removed from configuration and will no longer check writes. This cannot be undone; its history is retained. To enable it again later, disable it instead.
explanationPlaceholder: E.g. The two units must not run at the same time.
